2fa.title: Two Factor Authentication
2fa.googleDescription: Google Authenticator adds an extra layer of security to your online accounts by adding a second step of verification when you sign in. In addition to your password, you'll need to enter a code generated by the app on your phone.
2fa.confirmationToEnable: To enable 2 factor authentication (Powered by Google)?
2fa.confirmationToDisable: To disable 2 factor authentication (Powered by Google)?
